Namaste uncle, Irfan bol raha hoon, plum.text: Irfan says the hirer had mentioned a geyser job.
Namaste uncle, Irfan bol raha hoon, plum.quote: Namaste uncle, Irfan bol raha hoon, plumber. Geyser ka bola tha aapne?

Haan Irfan. Bathroom wala geyser garam h.text: Ramakant says the bathroom geyser is not heating and it is a Racold geyser.
Haan Irfan. Bathroom wala geyser garam h.quote: Haan Irfan. Bathroom wala geyser garam hi nahi kar raha. Racold ka hai, chhe saal purana hai.

Thermostat ya element hoga. Aake dekhna.text: Irfan says the visit and thermostat replacement will cost 800 rupees.
Thermostat ya element hoga. Aake dekhna.quote: Visit aur thermostat badalne ka 800 lagega.

Thermostat ya element hoga. Aake dekhna.text: Irfan says it will be necessary to come and look at the geyser.
Irfan says the problem may be the thermostat or the element.

800 to bahut zyada hai bhai, pichhli baa.text: Ramakant says 800 is too much, mentioning that someone did it for 500 last time.
800 to bahut zyada hai bhai, pichhli baa.quote: 800 to bahut zyada hai bhai, pichhli baar 500 mein kiya tha kisi ne.

Uncle naya thermostat hi 400 ka aata hai.text: The worker says the job amount should be 650 rupees.
Uncle naya thermostat hi 400 ka aata hai.quote: Uncle naya thermostat hi 400 ka aata hai. Chaliye 650 kar dijiye.

Theek hai, 650. Kal subah aa jaoge?.text: The hirer accepts the 650 rupees price.
Theek hai, 650. Kal subah aa jaoge?.quote: Theek hai, 650. Kal subah aa jaoge?

Haan kal subah das baje tak aa jaunga. A.text: The worker says he will come tomorrow morning by 10 o'clock.
Haan kal subah das baje tak aa jaunga. A.quote: Haan kal subah das baje tak aa jaunga.

Haan kal subah das baje tak aa jaunga. A.text: The worker says that if the element is also burned out, an extra 1,200 rupees will be charged.
Haan kal subah das baje tak aa jaunga. A.quote: Agar element bhi jala hua nikla to 1,200 alag lagega.

1,200 wala baad mein dekhenge, pehle the.text: The hirer says the 1,200-rupee charge can be discussed later.
1,200 wala baad mein dekhenge, pehle the.quote: 1,200 wala baad mein dekhenge, pehle thermostat lagao.

Theek hai uncle. Aur ek mahine mein phir.text: The worker says that if it stops working again within one month, he will fix it for free.
Theek hai uncle. Aur ek mahine mein phir.value: free repair if it fails again within one month
Theek hai uncle. Aur ek mahine mein phir.quote: Theek hai uncle. Aur ek mahine mein phir se band hua to free mein theek karunga.

Achha, ye sahi hai. Paise kaam ke baad c.text: The hirer says the rest will be paid in cash after the work is done.
Achha, ye sahi hai. Paise kaam ke baad c.quote: Achha, ye sahi hai. Paise kaam ke baad cash dunga.

Ji uncle, koi baat nahi. Kal milte hain..text: The worker says they will meet tomorrow.
Ji uncle, koi baat nahi. Kal milte hain..quote: Ji uncle, koi baat nahi. Kal milte hain.
